entries.title: Signed firmware images
entries.requirement: The TCU shall install only firmware images carrying a valid signature from the OEM signing authority and shall verify the signature before writing the image.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure integrity of firmware installed on the TCU.

entries.title: Mutual TLS for backend communication
entries.requirement: The TCU and the backend shall authenticate each other with X.509 certificates using TLS 1.2 or higher with approved cipher suites.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure authenticity of the backend and the TCU.

entries.title: Signed update manifest with pinned trust anchor
entries.requirement: The TCU shall verify the update manifest signature against a trust anchor stored in the HSM and shall reject manifests that fail verification.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure authenticity and integrity of update metadata.

entries.title: Secure boot verification before activation
entries.requirement: The TCU shall verify the bootloader and application image with the HSM-held root key at every boot and before activating a new partition.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure only authorised code executes on the TCU.

entries.title: Manifest freshness and expiry
entries.requirement: The TCU shall reject manifests that are expired or that carry a version counter lower than the stored counter.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent replay and freeze attacks on the update process.

entries.title: Anti-rollback protection
entries.requirement: The TCU shall maintain a monotonic version counter in protected storage and shall reject images with a lower security version.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent installation of older vulnerable firmware.

entries.title: Resilient update process
entries.requirement: The OTA client shall use an A/B partition scheme, shall resume interrupted downloads, and shall rate-limit retries to the backend.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Maintain availability of the TCU during update attacks and failures.

entries.title: HSM-protected signing environment
entries.requirement: The backend shall sign update artefacts only inside an HSM with role separation and dual control for signing key use.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Protect the update-signing key from compromise.

entries.title: UDS security access with strong authentication
entries.requirement: The TCU shall grant privileged diagnostic sessions only after challenge-response authentication with non-reusable seeds and a lockout after repeated failures.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent unauthorised diagnostic sessions.

entries.title: Diagnostic service restrictions
entries.requirement: The TCU shall restrict programming and security-relevant diagnostic services to authenticated sessions and shall end sessions after a timeout.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Limit what a diagnostic session can do.

entries.title: Access control per data identifier
entries.requirement: The TCU shall enforce a minimum session level for each diagnostic data identifier and shall not expose personal data by identifier.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Protect confidentiality of data read through diagnostics.

entries.title: Diagnostic gateway filtering and rate limiting
entries.requirement: The diagnostic gateway shall validate frame format and limit request rates per source.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Maintain availability of the diagnostic stack.

entries.title: Message authentication for CAN
entries.requirement: The TCU shall authenticate safety-relevant and command CAN messages using SecOC with a MAC and shall discard messages that fail verification.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure authenticity of CAN signals.

entries.title: Freshness values for authenticated messages
entries.requirement: Authenticated CAN messages shall carry a freshness value and the receiver shall discard messages with stale freshness.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent replay of CAN messages.

entries.title: Gateway filtering, rate limiting and intrusion detection
entries.requirement: The gateway shall forward only allow-listed message identifiers between domains, limit rates per identifier, and report violations to the intrusion detection function.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Contain bus attacks and maintain availability of CAN signals.

entries.title: Domain segregation with allow-list routing
entries.requirement: Network domains shall be segregated and inter-domain routing shall be limited to explicitly approved flows.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent lateral movement between vehicle domains.

entries.title: HSM key storage
entries.requirement: Private keys and root keys shall be generated and stored in the HSM and shall not be exportable in clear text.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Protect confidentiality of cryptographic keys.

entries.title: Port authentication on automotive Ethernet
entries.requirement: The Ethernet switch shall allow only authenticated devices on a port using IEEE 802.1X or equivalent.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent rogue devices on the vehicle Ethernet.

entries.title: SOME/IP service authentication
entries.requirement: SOME/IP service offers and subscriptions shall be authenticated and authorised.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure authenticity of Ethernet services.

entries.title: Encryption of inter-domain Ethernet traffic
entries.requirement: Inter-domain Ethernet traffic carrying personal or sensitive data shall be protected with MACsec or TLS.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Protect confidentiality of Ethernet service data.

entries.title: Secure switch configuration
entries.requirement: Switch configuration shall disable unused ports and native VLAN trunking, and shall be integrity protected.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent VLAN hopping and misconfiguration.

entries.title: Encryption and minimisation of telematics data
entries.requirement: Telematics data shall be encrypted in transit and at rest, limited to the purposes approved by data protection, and access to it shall be logged.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Protect confidentiality of personal telematics data.

entries.title: Authorised and signed remote commands
entries.requirement: Remote commands shall be signed by the backend, bound to a session and a timestamp, and checked against authorisation rules before execution.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent forged or replayed remote commands.

entries.title: Debug interface lock-down
entries.requirement: Production devices shall have JTAG and UART debug access disabled or protected by authenticated unlock.
entries.cybersecurity_goal: Prevent firmware and key extraction through debug ports.
